proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11742 vidyut explicitly gives Gujarati vīj and Punjabi bijj lightning. Bare bij/vij selects this noun; vidyullatā 11745 contains the distinct bijlī/bijurī extended series. Exact survey form bij is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
